verdict.rationale: Letta documents an official CLI (Letta Code) with an interactive mode driven by slash commands (/agents, /fork, /remember, /init, /doctor, /search) and a default local mode that needs no login. A headless mode supports scripts, CI/CD and UNIX composition, with --ephemeral for one-shot tasks, and there are CLI subcommands such as `letta shared-memory create`. The probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists, and Letta employees discuss Letta Code on HN. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of CLI quality from non-Letta users.
